## Summary

Describe the operator- or agent-visible change.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] API and MCP compatibility considered (agent-relevant actions stay scriptable)
- [ ] Local security boundary unchanged, or the change is documented in `README.md` and `SECURITY.md`
- [ ] Docs updated where applicable
- [ ] Fixtures and examples contain synthetic data only, and no machine-specific absolute paths
